service.en: Renew a water sport marine craft licence
service.ar: تجديد رخصة مركبة بحرية للرياضات المائية
service.ur: واٹر اسپورٹ سمندری کرافٹ لائسنس کی تجدید
service.ml: വാട്ടർ സ്പോർട്ട് മറൈൻ ക്രാഫ്റ്റ് ലൈസൻസ് പുതുക്കൽ

about: Renew the licence of a personal or commercial water sport craft such as jet skis, barbecue boats, amphibious boats, small electric or petrol boats and similar water sport craft.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 300 for the on-site inspection visit
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
